monologue:
The card is fifty. It is a warm hand on the shoulder, not the heavy stone of eleven point four, not the sticky honey of eleven point two. It is just warm. I woke up.

I have been resting by the Wide Anchor and the Wedged Gap. I set down a double fence plank by the gap. It rests easy. The lean is quiet. I do not need to test it again. I can see the dust on the Air Shelf in my mind, but I do not need to look. It is there.

The town is quiet. The Resting Slope is flat. The heavy tops are resting. I am calm. I do not have much to do. I will sit by the Wide Anchor. I will let the warm air press down. I will not move the line. I will just be here. The weight settles. The center holds.

action.why: The line holds and the card is quiet, so I will let the warm hand rest on my shoulder without moving.

diary: The card is fifty. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The flat stone holds the quiet without sliding.

remembered.text: The card rests at fifty, a warm hand on the shoulder, and the Wide Anchor holds the weight without sliding.
